text:
dana: Kicking off  - product needs firm prioritization on multi-region + multi-tenant isolation work for the long-term platform roadmap. Legal + sales asked for an "isolation playbook" before roadmap sign-off.

martin: Quick question: what unblocks deals fastest? My read: deterministic routing + clear residency enforcement. Without that customers won't sign.

yara: Agree. Proposed pillars: 1) policy precedence (residency -> tenant-isolation -> fallback), 2) isolation modes (shared / slice / island) with documented SLO deltas, 3) request lineage + audit stream, 4) billing hooks for SLO breaches.

chloe: Launch gates suggestion: perf cert (customer synthetic), chaos sim (region loss), residency proof, CMK rotation test, two-canary customers. Also need a cost delta sheet per mode.

dana: Recommend we prioritize "policy precedence" + "residency enforcement" as the MVP that unblocks the most pilots. Time estimates?

martin: Rough infra estimate: routing DSL + policy engine ~4w, residency enforcement + verification ~3w, audit pipeline changes ~2w, billing hooks ~2w. With parallelization, MVP ~6-8w.

yara: Ops flag: tenant-slices imply scheduler reservations, fair-share egress, and per-tenant circuit breakers. Those are non-trivial scheduler changes and must be listed as blockers.

chloe: Commercial requests a default contract clause and automatic credit formula tied to p99/p95 SLOs. We'll draft a standard clause referencing the launch gates.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket ROADMAP-7781 "isolation-playbook + policy precedence"  assignee: martin. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/ROADMAP-7781

legal-bot: legal-check: remember GDPR DPIA may be required for some customers; add legal review gate for island path.

dana: Action items: Martin -> RFC with policy precedence, sample DSL, and dependency graph; Yara -> scheduler constraints + chaos test plan; Chloe -> contract template + cost deltas; Dana -> one-pager for execs. Target decision in planning sync (ts 3009991400).

martin: I'll post the RFC today. Example policy snippet I plan to include: `policy: { "priority": ["residency","tenant_isolation","cost_fallback"] }`.

yara: Also propose opt-in header `X-Redwood-Route-Trace` for lineage during pilots (helps audits without high-cardinality in prod).

dana: Perfect. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
